notes.title: Game update to version 1.5

Game updated to version 1.5

-Optimized performance for "Over The Mountain" level. Also improved mountain's look.
-Fixed interact symbol for Moose in "Spirit forest" level.

Happy gaming! 🧙‍♂️

notes.title: Update to version 1.4
notes.notes:
Stone Guardian updated to version 1.4

-Added vibration to game controller in "Down The Mountain" level if crashed in trees.
-Fixed issue when sometimes player kept moving while loading next scene.
-Fixed issue where jump action performed together with other actions, that caused player animation to 
"freeze" in falling animation. 
-Improved player jumping.
-If player dies and revives or scene reloads after player dies, player`s health is restored to its max level.
-Some timeline fixes in "Magic Entrance" level.

Thanks to all who are reporting me bugs and other issues!
I appreciate the support and help!
Happy gaming!🧙🏻
